prefix: call the local scene-resource service tail
mode17_service.resource_gate: when INTERACTION_RESOURCE_PROGRESS_COUNTER is not the ASCII string 000, call Frame_RunServicePass and the local VDP hook/command tail
mode17_service.audio_gate: when SCENE_VDP_UPDATE_FLAG is set, prepare/send the scene audio command before returning

initialization: clear actors and initialize VDP registers
acquire the Z80 bus and publish the VDP command pointer
clear the bus request and invoke SceneResource_RunMode17Service
start the palette transition and restore the VDP display register
mode17_setup.range_boundary: The setup returns at 0x001B1DD7; the adjacent 0x001B1DD8 entry is the separate RTS-only hook.
